elaine: quick PSA 10: PR 1042 merged but the tracing-hooks migration doc still references a dead link (/v1/traces/setup). can someone swap it before the next release?

ravi: where exactly? i can do a tiny fix PR for the URL + update the python snippet at the top.

elaine: under the 'Install the hook' heading. the python example also uses the old Client.init signature which fails with sdk v2. snippet currently: `from redwood_sdk import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")`

sofia: ah yes we changed that in 2.1. new usage is `from redwood_sdk import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))` and we usually show env var examples. i'll open a docs PR to handle link + snippet.

mike: can you add a one-line pointer to Console > Observability > Cost breakdown? folks keep opening support tickets after migrating. a small pointer in the migration doc should reduce noise.

sofia: will add a single-line callout and a screenshot placeholder. do we have a canonical URL for that dashboard?

ravi: use /console/observability/token-costs?utm=docs or the absolute: https://app.redwood.ai/console/observability/costs — it redirects in prod.

elaine: also noticed the tracing snippet references span attribute `service.version` which we no longer emit. can we either remove it or mark it as legacy?

sofia: i'll replace it with `span.set_attribute("deployment", "blue")` and add a note: "If upgrading from releases before 2024-10, older attribute names may appear."

mike: can we include a short legacy shim for folks on older SDKs? a tiny `if hasattr` fallback would save support triage.\
ravi: suggestion for shim: ```python
from redwood_sdk import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
# legacy fallback for older SDKs
if not hasattr(client, "track_span"):
    def track_span(name, **attrs):
        return client.create_span(name, attributes=attrs)
    client.track_span = track_span
```

elaine: that looks good. last item: doc-bot flagged an orphaned image: `![trace-costs](https://storage.redwood.ai/missing/trace-costs.png)` which 404s in the site build. replace it or remove?

sofia: i'll swap it for the new screenshot from the design bucket and include alt text.\
doc-bot: automated check report: PR 1045 by sofia includes link fix, sdk snippet update, shim example, screenshot replacement. CI preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1045 10 rendering shows no broken links on staging.

mike: quick review done. please add a changelog bullet under the migration page "what changed": one line saying "SDK v2: client initialization and span attribute names updated — see migration snippet" and update the date.

sofia: added the changelog bullet and bumped the last-updated date. pushing commit now.

ravi: LGTM. pinging @docs-rollback for visibility in case of a hotfix.

elaine: thanks all. i'll include in the upcoming 2024-11 console release notes and follow up if QA finds anything. :thumbsup:

mike: nice work, thanks. :rocket:
